rules.reason: State modules may depend on domain/runtime helpers, not workspace shell UI.
Command palette metadata should not reach into workspace shell internals. Runtime store-access wrappers live under workspace/runtime/ (REF-CQ-07).
cmdPalette files are metadata; runtime store access belongs in workspace/runtime/ (ARCH-CQ-01, pairs with REF-CQ-07).
Command palette metadata must stay declarative and not import rendering entrypoints.
3D rendering modules should stay independent from workspace chrome.
3D viewport helpers may share geometry contracts, not import the plan canvas entrypoint.
Inspector renderers should stay property/editor focused and not import app or rendering entrypoints.
Pure plan interaction and selection helpers should remain reusable and UI-free.
API descriptor modules must not import the monolithic route layer.
Backend command/domain helpers must stay independent from route handlers.
Backend command/domain helpers should not depend on API descriptor registry modules.

rules.rationale: Workspace files must not import workspace/index.ts — that pattern recreates the chain-import cycle bug fixed in PR #144.
rules.reason: Workspace files must not import workspace/index.ts (or .tsx). Side-effect chain-imports at the bottom of a file create circular-import cycles where named imports resolve to `undefined` under Vite/Vitest CommonJS-interop — the exact bug class fixed by PR #144. No workspace/index.ts exists today; this rule prevents reintroduction.
